race.comment: SNAP DECISION (5) win record hardly excites but looks to find a winnable race fourth up. Drifted back with the 60.5kg when a dismal ninth over 1600m at Goulburn. Assess on the good second two back when a fast-finishing second at Goulburn. Visors go on and no shock to see a return to winning form. EVOKES (12) deep into the prep and drops in trip for this. Snagged back from the draw and held his ground to the line when sixth over 2010m at Moruya. Leading player who finds a suitable race. SHOWMARA (2) improved sharply when he dropped in class for a dominant victory over 1400m at Mudgee. Looks to have further upside and proven at the mile. Each way. MYSTIC DIVA (7) slashing run second up when placing at Canberra. Gets the claim again and don't dismiss.
